facts.text: I am thinking of getting new feed for my pigs.
I heard about a new feed brand that is better for pigs' digestive health.
I bought a new set of cow bells for my herd of 10 cows.
My old cow bells were getting rusty and making a weird sound.
I am thinking of asking other farmers in the area about their experience with the new feed brand.
I am thinking of checking the feed's nutritional content and comparing it to what my pigs are currently getting.
I picked up fencing materials to fix the chicken coop at the farm supply store.
I have had issues with predators getting into the chicken coop at night.
I am going to add extra fencing and fortify the doors to address predator issues.
I am thinking of getting advice from other farmers in the area about how they've handled predator issues in their chicken coops.
I am planning to ask around about the new feed brand at the next farm meeting.
I am thinking of talking to our veterinarian about the new feed brand.
Our veterinarian has worked with us on our animals' health issues in the past.
